# Open 0.1.10 (12)
Engine: Chromium 156.0.8078.48 · CEF 4fa4ab5. macOS 26 or later, Apple silicon.
This release fixes Microsoft Outlook sign-in and cross-site authentication/form flows opening in Peek, and fixes Easel shapes not redrawing when resized.
## Sign-in, passkeys, and Peek - Fixed Microsoft Outlook sign-in failing with `AADSTS10040141: The request is invalid.` when signing in from a Pinned tab, Favorite, or Peek. - Prevented `POST` requests, form submissions (`POST` and `GET`), client/server redirects, and history traversals from being cancelled and reopened as `GET` in Peek or Little Open. - Exempted cross-site identity, SSO, OAuth, SAML, and FIDO/passkey bridge flows from automatic Peek on Pinned and Favorite tabs while preserving explicit Shift-click Peek and ordinary external link Peek.
## Easels - Fixed Easel shapes and canvas objects not redrawing when resized until another property change forced a repaint.
